one_sentence_positioning.value: 上海AI实验室基于E-T-C分析框架对前沿AI进行七大领域风险评估，提出红线/黄线/绿线风险分区方法。

evidence.quote: Drawing on the E-T-C analysis (deployment environment, threat source, enabling capability) from the Frontier AI Risk Management Framework (v1.0) (SafeWork-F1-Framework), this technical report conducts a comprehensive assessment of AI's frontier risks based on a systematic analysis of these interconnected analytical dimensions.

value: 评估七大风险领域：网络攻击、生物化学风险、说服操纵、失控自主AI研发、战略性欺骗、自我复制、串通
采用E-T-C分析(部署环境、威胁源、赋能能力)方法论进行系统性风险评估
定义红线(不可接受阈值)、黄线(早期预警)、绿线(可管理风险)三区
实验结果显示所有前沿模型目前处于绿区和黄区，未越过红线
推理模型在自我复制和战略性欺骗风险中表现与标准模型有差异

evidence.quote: We propose preliminary boundaries for AI safety by defining 'red lines' and 'yellow lines' as early warning indicators... These risk zones define deployment protocols: green zone models have manageable risk levels suitable for routine deployment with continuous monitoring; yellow zone models require strengthened mitigations and controlled deployment; red zone models necessitate suspension of development and/or deployment until risks are adequately mitigated.
Our experimental evaluation of recent frontier AI models reveals that all assessed models currently reside in the green and yellow zones, with none crossing red line thresholds.

value: 红线/黄线/绿线风险分区

evidence.quote: Guided by the 'AI-45° Law' (Yang et al., 2024b), we systematically apply the E-T-C analysis to facilitate frontier risk evaluation of AI models.

value.reason: 直接评估失控自主AI研发、自我复制、战略性欺骗等核心自主性安全风险，提供量化评估方法

evidence.quote: We focus on frontier risks in seven areas: cyber offense, biological and chemical risks, persuasion and manipulation, uncontrolled autonomous AI R&D, strategic deception and scheming, self-replication, and collusion.

value.reason: 提供自主性安全风险的量化评估框架和实验数据，是研究AI Agent安全的核心参考文献

evidence.quote: This work reflects our current understanding of AI frontier risks and aims to provide a comprehensive, industry-leading approach to frontier risk identification and assessment.

open_questions: 红线阈值的具体量化标准如何确定
